item.title: Departing BBC boss warns network on 'knife edge' amid Trump documentary lawsuit, trust crisis
item.summary: BBC director-general acknowledges “knife edge" moment as financial pressures grow following Trump speech editing dispute.

item.title: Kidnapped child found alive after years hidden under fake name: police
item.summary: Kidnapped girl found safe in North Carolina after nearly six years missing from California. The now-11-year-old was discovered living under a fake name in Washington County.

item.title: Country singer Colter Wall cancels tour, admits he is ‘mentally unwell’
item.summary: Country singer Colter Wall cancels his remaining 2026 tour dates and is taking an indefinite break from live performances to focus on his mental health and well-being.

item.title: Shooting in Old Dominion University hall injures two; gunman dead
item.summary: A suspected gunman in Virginia was killed Thursday after opening fire inside Constant Hall at Old Dominion University, injuring two individuals.

item.title: Judge says no new trial for Laken Riley killer Jose Ibarra
item.summary: Breaking: Georgia judge denies Jose Ibarra's motion for new trial in Laken Riley murder case. Venezuelan migrant's life sentence without parole remains intact.

item.title: Ex-NFL star cautions league about 'giving fans too much' as Thanksgiving Eve game reportedly eyed
item.summary: Former NFL star Shawne Merriman appeared on OutKick's "Don't @ Me with Dan Dakich" and warned the NFL about potentially watering down its product.

item.title: Trump-backed affordable housing overhaul clears Senate, while House GOP raises red flags
item.summary: Major affordable housing legislation advanced through the Senate with measures to help first-time buyers, while critics raised build-to-rent supply concerns.

item.title: Clyburn, 85, bucks Democrat generational revolt with bid for 18th term in Congress
item.summary: Jim Clyburn announces bid for 18th term in Congress at age 85, defying calls for generational change as other Democratic leaders choose to retire

item.title: Hall of Famer Tony Dungy announces NBC let him go after 17 seasons on their pregame show
item.summary: Hall of Fame coach Tony Dungy announced that NBC will not be bringing him back to their pregame show "Football Night in America" after 17 seasons.

item.title: Travis Kelce insists Chiefs return in 2026 was never in doubt: 'Hungry to get back'
item.summary: After confirming his return to the NFL for the 2026 season, tight end Travis Kelce revealed he made the decision last year but took time to ensure he avoided any emotional choices.
